motion_rule: he never stops: he drives down a checkout belt at the lens, the camera racing backwards ahead of him so the shelves tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; head half the frame, closer from 6.7; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; camera move every beat, never on a schedule
character: a lanky chameleon in a grey shop apron, swivel eyes, deadpan, tail whipping, skin ripping to a new colour every beat
second_characters: ONE lean beetle clerk in a green visor on the belt behind him
props: ONE fat green cricket in a paper tray on the belt, caving smaller under his own feet
prop_continuity: the cricket keeps the same green and only its size drops: full to 3.6, half from 4.5, a pea from 6.7, a crumb from 8.3; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a narrow supermarket aisle, shelves packed with jars to the ceiling both sides, the belt racing under him, hard noon sun
light_events: sun bars strobe his face every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA-yu, BYS-tre-e, in-FLYA-tsi-ya, me-NYA-et, STO-i-most, e-DY
audio.pacing: 0.4-2.2 one breath; pause to 2.9; 2.9-4.5 one breath; pause to 5.3; 5.3-7.6 one breath; after 7.6 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: the belt humming, packets rattling, a wet snap when his tongue fires, a crunch as it caves

timeline.a: tight on his tongue firing into the lens and snapping back, skin ripping grey to orange, shelves tearing past
he hurls himself down the racing belt at the lens on all fours, orange ripping to blue
he lunges over the tray at the lens, three colours ripping across him, the fat cricket bouncing at his nose
his tongue fires at the tray and rips it to his chest along the belt
he drags the tray under his chest and rides it at the lens
he slams both front feet on the tray and the cricket under them caves to half its size
he shoulders the beetle off the belt, the half cricket bouncing in the tray at his nose
he charges down the racing belt at the lens, violet ripping to yellow
he yanks the tray to his jaws and the cricket in it caves to a pea
he drives at the lens over the tray, front feet slamming the belt, four colours ripping across him
his tongue fires the length of the aisle at the pea, jars tearing past
the tongue comes back with a crumb on its tip and the empty tray spins past the lens
he presses his face onto a jar racing past and turns its exact colour, only his eyes carving out of it
he throws himself into the lens, jaws wide, the bare crumb dead centre on his tongue tip

must_appear: at 3.6 his front feet slam the tray and the cricket caves to half; at 6.0 it caves to a pea; at 9.0 he presses his face onto a jar racing past and turns its exact colour, only his eyes carving out; at 9.5 he throws himself into the lens, jaws wide, the bare crumb dead centre on his tongue tip
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, two characters moving at once, duplicate props, floating objects, foreign accent, a parked camera, a still background, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a hero moving away from the lens, a held pose, slow motion, cyrillic letters, readable text, a glowing emblem, extra limbs, the cricket changing colour, speech after 7.6
